title: Cognitive Gateway Skill Definition
description: The strict v1 repository contract for a reusable skill requirement.

schema_version.description: The only supported skill-document schema version.

owner_agent_id.description: Optional typed AgentId ownership; null means the skill is reusable without one owner.

dependency_ids.description: Ordered, unique SkillId dependencies. Dependency cycles are rejected by the catalog.

required_capability_ids.description: Ordered, unique abstract CapabilityId requirements; these do not grant permission.

knowledge_queries.description: Ordered retrieval hints represented by CG-02 KnowledgeQuery values.

identifier.description: The CG-02 identifier grammar: ASCII alphanumeric edges and ASCII identifier punctuation inside.

description.description: Required non-whitespace text; domain validation also rejects disallowed control characters.

source.description: Original repository path or other source identifier.
